title: Tru Tien Episode 11: The Shadow Army
audience: Fans of Korean fantasy, Solo Leveling viewers, action fans, 18-35 demographic
tone: Power awakening, army building, tension, rising legend

concept.hook: Jin-Woo had been collecting shadows for months. Today — he opened his shadow army for the first time. One by one they rose. Fifty shadows. Sixty. A hundred. Each one stronger than the last S-rank hunter.
concept.story_arc: Shadow collection montage → Jin-Woo decides to reveal his army → Hundreds of shadows rise → The hunters watch in disbelief → 'It's... it's an ARMY?' → Jin-Woo's power revealed
concept.emotion: Preparation → Decision → Revelation → Disbelief → Shock → Legendary moment

shots.prompt: Fast montage — Jin-Woo absorbing shadows. A giant orc shadow sucked into his hand. A knight shadow kneeling. A shadow archer firing. Jin-Woo in the dungeon alone, collecting power. Camera: fast montage — shadow absorption moments, giant shadow being absorbed, knight shadow kneeling, power growing silently. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Fast montage — shadow absorption from dungeons, giant shadow being absorbed, knight shadow kneeling, Jin-Woo growing stronger, 6s
shots.narration: For months — Jin-Woo had been collecting them. Every dungeon raid. Every shadow that fell. He saved them all.
shots.sfx: Shadow absorption sound, dungeon echoes, power growing, his cold determination, shadow kneeling

shots.prompt: Wide shot — Jin-Woo stands in an empty underground chamber. He raises his hand. Shadow starts to rise. One. Five. Ten. Twenty. Fifty. Camera: wide — Jin-Woo raising hand, shadows rising one by one, count growing rapidly, underground chamber filling with shadows. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — Jin-Woo raising hand, shadows rising one by one rapidly, count increasing, underground chamber filling, 6s
shots.narration: He raised his hand. They answered. One shadow rose. Then five. Then fifty. His shadow army — was real.
shots.sfx: Shadows rising, power humming, count increasing, wind in chamber, ominous music building

shots.prompt: Wide shot — A HUNDRED shadows kneel in formation. Giant shadows kneel in front. Knight shadows flank. Archer shadows stand ready. Jin-Woo stands before them — their king. Camera: wide — hundred shadows kneeling in military formation, giant shadows front, knight flanks, Jin-Woo standing as their king. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — hundred shadows kneeling in military formation, Jin-Woo as their king, shadow army assembled, 6s
shots.narration: A hundred shadows. Giant warriors. Knights. Archers. All kneeling before him. His shadow army — numbered one hundred.
shots.sfx: Shadows kneeling in unison, military formation sound, wind echoing, power aura, Jin-Woo's breathing

shots.prompt: Close-up — outside the chamber, two hunters peek through. They see the shadow army. Their faces go pale. One falls backward. 'A... an ARMY?!' Camera: close-up — two hunters' pale shocked faces peeking into chamber, shadow army visible behind, fear and disbelief, one falling backward. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — two hunters' pale shocked faces peeking, shadow army visible behind, fear and disbelief, one falling backward, 6s
shots.narration: Two hunters had followed him in. Now they stood frozen in terror. Because what Jin-Woo commanded — was not one shadow. It was an army.
shots.sfx: Hunters' shocked gasps, one falling backward, terrified whispering, shadow army humming, fear silence

shots.prompt: Close-up — Jin-Woo lowers his hand. The shadow army DISSOLVES into darkness. He walks past the frozen hunters without a word. His voice echoes: 'Tell them. Tell them what you saw.' Camera: close-up — Jin-Woo lowering hand, army dissolving into darkness, walking past frozen hunters, cold voice echoing final words. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — shadow army dissolving into darkness, Jin-Woo walking past frozen hunters, cold echoing voice, 6s
shots.narration: He dissolved the army as quickly as he had summoned it. And as he walked past the frozen hunters — one sentence. 'Tell them. Tell them what you saw.'
shots.sfx: Shadows dissolving, his footsteps, cold echoing voice, silence in chamber, ominous aftermath

audio.narration: For months — Jin-Woo had been collecting them. Every dungeon raid. Every shadow that fell. He saved them all. He raised his hand. They answered. One shadow rose. Then five. Then fifty. His shadow army — was real. A hundred shadows. Giant warriors. Knights. Archers. All kneeling before him. His shadow army — numbered one hundred. Two hunters had followed him in. Now they stood frozen in terror. Because what Jin-Woo commanded — was not one shadow. It was an army. He dissolved the army as quickly as he had summoned it. And as he walked past the frozen hunters — one sentence. 'Tell them. Tell them what you saw.'
audio.bg_music: Dark epic Korean fantasy orchestral, shadow army awakening, hundred shadows, mystery and power 90 BPM

sfx.sound: Shadows dissolving, cold footsteps, echoing voice
